messages:
rowan: tiny watercooler thought: what if we made a serialized office sitcom where every device is a character? :tv:
amir: love this. 'Thermostat: wise but dramatic'; 'Printer: flaky sidekick'; 'Fridge: questionable gourmet'.
tess: i'm casting roles. Thermostat = noir detective, Printer = tired intern, Fridge = enigmatic food critic. gerry is the cameo as 'CI/CD' the unstoppable courier. :detective:
gerry: honoured. also my opening line will be 'deploys happen, so do feelings.' dramatic, right? :microphone:
rowan: short sample scene idea: Thermostat monologue about temperature drift, Printer interrupts with a paper jam soliloquy, Fridge serves a mysterious lime. quick, absurd, 90s sitcom energy.
amir: we should add a tiny running gag: every episode ends with a model misconfiguration joke and a muffin.
tess: i'll write the pilot 'The One With The Warm Bias' and slip an easter-egg prompt into the kitchen. can someone make a theme jingle? 8-bit synth pls. :musical_note:
ops-bot: note logged: 'office_sitcom_pilot_proposal' created by tess. optional audition at 4pm. :clapper:
gerry: if this happens, i'm requesting a credit sequence where everyone is listed as 'voice of their device.' also tiny merch idea: 'I watched the kitchen drama.' :tshirt:
